rationale: Stable v1.80.1 already returns no Thickness hover while its dialog is open, leaving the edited wall unmarked. The actual implementation adds only bounded, cursor-independent session presentation resolved from the existing dialog target and current geometry, with existing width, palette and live-editor ownership. No persistent fields, geometry or Apply semantics change.

summary.ru: Редактируемая стена остаётся выделенной, пока открыт диалог толщины, в том числе при переносе диалога и навигации по плану.
summary.en: The edited wall stays highlighted while its thickness dialog is open, including when moving the dialog or navigating the plan.
